description: This file defines the interface for the AVB (Android Verified Boot) functionality within the Cuttlefish project, including the Avb class, related structures, and utility functions for handling AVB metadata and images.

classes.name: ChainPartition
classes.description: Represents a partition in the AVB system with its name, rollback index, and key path.

classes.name: Avb
classes.description: Provides methods to manipulate AVB images, including signing, verifying, and creating metadata images.

methods.name: Avb(std::string avbtool_path)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Avb with the path to the avbtool.

methods.name: Avb(std::string avbtool_path, std::string algorithm, std::string key)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Avb with specific algorithm and key.

methods.name: AddHashFooter
methods.description: Signs and adds a hash footer to a partition image for verification.

methods.name: WriteInfoImage
methods.description: Creates an info image from a given image.

methods.name: MakeVbMetaImage
methods.description: Generates a VBMeta image with chained partitions and extra arguments.

methods.name: GenerateAddHashFooter
methods.description: Generates a command to add hash footer.

methods.name: GenerateInfoImage
methods.description: Generates a command to create an info image.

methods.name: GenerateMakeVbMetaImage
methods.description: Generates a command to create a VBMeta image.
